title: Leases
intro: المستأجر يسجل **أصل حق استخدام** و**التزام عقد إيجار** لكل العقود تقريباً.
الالتزام = القيمة الحالية لدفعات الإيجار، مخصومة بالمعدل الضمني أو **معدل الاقتراض الإضافي**.
إعفاءات اختيارية: العقود **قصيرة الأجل (12 شهر أو أقل)** والأصول **منخفضة القيمة**.

tf.s: Lessees classify leases as finance or operating under IFRS 16.
tf.why: Only lessors classify. Lessees use one model.

tf.s: The lease term includes extension periods if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise the option.
tf.why: That is part of the lease term.

tf.s: If ownership does not transfer, the ROU asset is depreciated over the shorter of the lease term and its useful life.
Lessors recognise operating lease income usually on a straight-line basis.
Interest on the lease liability is included in depreciation.
tf.why: Interest is a finance cost; depreciation is on the ROU asset.

tf.s: A lessee may choose not to recognise ROU assets for leases of 12 months or less.

fill.s: At commencement, a lessee recognises a right-of-use asset and a lease ___.
If the implicit rate is not available, use the lessee's incremental ___ rate.
Short-term leases have a term of ___ months or less.
A finance lease transfers substantially all the risks and ___ of ownership.

source: Written for IFRS Play from the standard's core requirements. Exact source reference could not be verified from the uploaded document.

je.s: A lease starts. The present value of lease payments is 50,000.
je.why: Lessee recognises ROU asset and lease liability.

je.s: Year-end: interest on the lease liability is 4,000 and the annual payment of 12,000 is made.
je.why: Payment covers interest 4,000 and reduces the liability by 8,000.

calc.s: Lease liability on 1 January 40,000, rate 8%, payment 10,000 on 31 December. Closing liability?
ROU asset 60,000. Lease term 5 years, useful life 8 years, no transfer of ownership. Annual depreciation?
calc.why: Shorter of lease term and useful life: 60,000 / 5 = 12,000.

steps: Check whether the contract contains a lease
Measure the lease liability at PV of payments
Measure the ROU asset (liability + direct costs + prepayments - incentives)
Depreciate the asset and unwind interest on the liability

classify.s: نسجل أصل والتزام ولا نستخدم الإعفاء؟

multi.s: Which are included in lease payments? (select all)
opts: Purchase option price if reasonably certain
Variable payments based on future sales
Termination penalty if the term reflects termination
multi.why: Sales-based variable payments are expensed when incurred.
